blocks.heading: What would be needed to build one
items: A results spine (nba_api or Basketball Reference) with dates, scores, home/away and rest days
A betting-blind Elo tuned on held-out seasons, as the other four sports have
Then roster/availability inputs, the biggest signal in basketball

report_card.summary: No report card: nothing is predicted, so nothing is graded. Accuracy, log loss, Brier and calibration do not exist for basketball.

improvements.summary: The only honest candidate is whether to build a model at all.

items: Decide whether basketball stays an odds-tracking page or gets a model (open question for TW).
If it gets one: the odds archive already holds 1023 snapshots since 2025-10-27, so a closing-line benchmark exists from day one.
